title: Water Damage Checklist
description: What to photograph and record before cleanup starts, if a pipe, appliance, or storm has left standing water in your home.

groups.title: Immediate Actions
items: Shut off the water source if you can identify it
Note the date and time you discovered the damage
Address safety concerns before documenting anything

groups.title: Document the Damage
items: Photograph the point of entry
Photograph the standing water level
Photograph affected walls and flooring
Photograph affected belongings

groups.title: Keep Records
items: Save any repair invoices
Save any plumber or restoration company estimates

title: Fire Damage Checklist
description: What to document before any cleanup begins, so nothing damaged gets discarded before it's recorded.

groups.title: Immediate Actions
items: Do not discard any damaged items before documenting them
Get the fire department report number
Address safety concerns before re-entering the property

groups.title: Document the Damage
items: Photograph every room, including smoke damage
Document all contents before any cleanup begins

groups.title: Keep Records
items: Save the fire department report
Save any restoration or cleanup estimates

title: Wind & Hail Checklist
description: What to photograph from the ground and what to save, after a storm leaves damage to your roof, siding, or windows.

groups.title: Immediate Actions
items: Photograph the roof from the ground — do not climb onto the roof
Photograph siding, windows, and fencing
Date-stamp photos the same day as the storm, if possible

groups.title: Document the Damage
items: Save a weather report or storm-date reference
Note the approximate time the storm occurred

groups.title: Keep Records
items: Save any temporary repair invoices (tarps, board-up services)

title: Theft Checklist
description: What to file and record first, if your home has been broken into or items have gone missing.

groups.title: Immediate Actions
items: File a police report and get the report number
Photograph any forced entry

groups.title: Document What's Missing
items: List missing items
Note approximate value and purchase date, if known

groups.title: Keep Records
items: Save the police report
Save any purchase receipts you can locate
